This conflicts with the retained board and the RFP cover/selection schedule, which retain October 6, 2026 at 5 PM Eastern. The addendum body lists its modifications and question entry as N/A. The schema requires an aware published_at timestamp although Addendum 1 states only a calendar date. 2026-09-22T00:00:00-04:00 is a date-only serialization convention, not an observed publication instant; exact publication time is unknown. The posted addendum requires a signed acknowledgment with any proposal and excludes that page from the limit. Capturing the blank official page supplies source evidence only. Its signed_acknowledgement remains false and the signed response document remains MISSING.

The question period and optional pre-bid meeting are closed. The board limits later communication to shortlisted interview scheduling and follow-up. No buyer or partner contact, registration, meeting, signature, pricing commitment or submission is authorized by this packet.

All original organization, team, project, capability, document and pricing facts remain unverified. The capture does not establish a prime/team commitment, current qualification, proposal completion, revenue or payment.

The current compile/verify CLI owns process UTC. Saved output is a dated observation; its five-minute current-receipt window is not extended by publication. Recheck official sources before any later owner decision.
